### God Anoints and Appoints
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-feb-27-2011-11646318.html
Passage: Numbers 16:1-3, 31-32
Points:
- Korah's jealousy toward Moses and Aaron was ultimately an attack against God, who chose and appointed them.
- Harboring envy and rebellion toward God-appointed leadership brings severe consequences upon a community.
- The Holy Spirit distributes different callings and gifts, both public and private, to different individuals.
- Believers must take critical thoughts captive to avoid speaking against the leaders God has established.
